name: book-studio-desktop
description: Book Studio Desktop — writer-first WYSIWYG book workspace for Windows and Linux
author: Book Studio <book-studio@users.noreply.github.com>

scripts.dev: npm run build:electron && concurrently -k -n vite,electron "vite" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && node -e \"require('child_process').spawn(require('electron'), ['.'], { stdio: 'inherit', env: { ...process.env, NODE_ENV: 'development' } })\""
scripts.dev:win: npm run build:electron && concurrently -k -n vite,electron "vite" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && set NODE_ENV=development&& electron ."
scripts.dev:linux: npm run build:electron && concurrently -k -n vite,electron "vite" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && NODE_ENV=development electron ."
scripts.build: npm run build:electron && npm run build:renderer
